review_notes: Independently read both complete owned files in canonical and rendered form, all subject and outgoing-link pages, all 308 lines of proposal.json, functionality.md, all 2193 lines of findings.json, link-dispositions.json and synthesis.json. The eight writes affect only owned function/TU subjects. No new entities, merges or links are proposed.

The proposed fixed iteration count, data[1..29] accesses, signed-16 selector narrowing, configured-slot scale selection, resolve-before-attach ordering and optional animation branches agree with canonical source. In particular, count is not an iteration bound, and missing component models do not prevent attachment-parent X/Y scale writes.

Independently checked Ground_801C4100 and HSD_JObjAddNext definitions. Traversal skips instance children and can leave the starting subtree through ancestors. AddNext wraps the existing chain rather than performing ordinary sibling insertion. When its input has a parent, the chain starts at that parent's first child; the initial owned call obtains precisely that first child.

The retained grFZeroCar_InitCarModels name is a descriptive hypothesis, not a recovered canonical spelling. Canonical grFZeroCar_801CAFBC and the canonical data symbols remain authoritative. Rendered substitutions were not used as independent evidence.

Caller search finds direct uses in grbigblue.c:524 with selector 30/mode 1, grmutecity.c:615 with selector 0x1C/mode 0, and grbigblueroute.c:442 with selector 30/mode 0. This supports shared stage-model construction but does not independently establish the exact hazard-concept relationship or asset geometry.

The mode operation is accurately delegated rather than given an unsupported alias. Independently inspected lb_8000F9F8: it sends JOBJ_UNK_B26 to child-hierarchy and conditional DObj helpers. The precise downstream rendering interpretation remains deferred.

Acceptance applies to the supported changes and explicit deferrals, not to proof of the 21 unresolved inherited claims. Section placement, object sizes and constant-pool order have not been established by compiled evidence.

Additional boundary review: no owned guard sanitizes zero, negative, NaN or infinite ground scale before XYZ multiplication. Active-slot zero defaults to 1.0f, though every initialized table row has one through four active slots. The only disabled-index test is equality to -1; other negative indices are not validated. The routine assumes valid input hierarchy/data and has no rollback or idempotence guard. Callback lifetime and archive ownership beyond local attachment remain explicitly unresolved below.

The selector has no local bounds checks. Valid archive/model ranges, nested descriptor pointers and whether lookup normalization is consistent with the separately computed signed descriptor offset require archive-loader definitions and assets.

The lifetime/ownership of archive-backed animation descriptions, synchronous versus retained callback behavior inside HSD_ForeachAnim, and final hierarchy teardown are not proved by this review. Mode's downstream rendering meaning remains delegated. lb_8000F9F8 forwards JOBJ_UNK_B26 through child/DObj helpers, but that numeric flag name is not independent semantic proof.

Ground-scale exceptional values are not locally filtered. The exact downstream setter behavior, custom JObj allocation defaults, quaternion interpretation under node flags and final rendered transforms are not independently established.
Finite, acyclic, suitably populated model hierarchies are assumed. Ground_801C4100 can ascend beyond a car root; no owned subtree boundary or cycle detector prevents malformed hierarchy traversal.
